metadata.title: EFC — Master Specification
metadata.author: Morten Magnusson
metadata.description: Numerical parameters and constants for the Energy-Flow Cosmology Master Specification

a_edge.description: Edge-coupling coefficient in c(S) = c0 (1 + a_edge x^2)

beta.description: Entropy-coupling exponent in Phi = A_Phi Ef (1 + S^beta). Baseline is linear (beta=1).

proportionality_Ef.description: Proportionality constant in Ef = -k nabla S (default k=1)

stability_band_half_width.description: Half-width of the transition/stability band around S_mid

c_min.description: Minimum effective light speed at S_mid (x=0), equals c0

c_at_endpoints.description: c(S) at S=S0 or S=S1 (x=±1), equals c0*(1+a_edge) with a_edge=1

structural_regimes.name: transition
structural_regimes.description: Stability band; c(S) near minimum; persistent halo-like structures
